items.title: 4 photo tips for your *website*

items.t: Use real photos of your shop or work
items.d: Not stock images from the internet.

items.t: Shoot in daylight, phone held straight

items.d: Big files make pages slow on the phone.

items.note: Save this for your next photo day.

items.title: "My customers are *all local.*"

items.d: That is the strength of a local business.

items.t: Nearby people check on the phone first
items.d: Timings, location and rates, before they visit.
Ask 5 customers how they found you.

items.title: A homepage for a *sweet shop*
items.sub: Timings, location and a WhatsApp button on the first screen.

items.title: Do customers ask your *timings* on WhatsApp?

items.q: Can I change things after launch?
items.a: Small changes are free for 30 days.

items.q: Do I get the website code?
items.a: Yes, the code is handed over to you.

items.q: Do we need to meet in person?
items.a: No. WhatsApp, video call and a demo link.
